title: ON-VEHICLE INSPECTION and ADJUSTMENT OF SLIDING ROOF

content.description: Overview illustration of vehicle sun roof showing the roof panel assembly from an exterior angled view

items:
(a) Start the engine and check the operation time of the sun roof.
Operation time: Approx. 5 secs.
(b) Check for abnormal noise or binding during operation.
(c) With sun roof fully closed, check for water leakage.
(d) Check for a level difference between the sliding panel and roof panel.
(e) If the sliding roof does not operate:
(1) Remove the cover of the control box.
(3) Manually operate the sun roof by inserting a large screwdriver into the hole and turning the drive shaft.

content.description: Illustration showing control box removal from both front and rear positions, with arrows indicating removal direction

content.text: (a) Before making adjustments, pull loose the clips and slide the headlining to the rear.
NOTE: When checking adjustment, reattach the headlining before sliding the roof.

content.description: Illustration showing hand pulling clip to release headlining, with arrow indicating rearward sliding direction

content.text: (b) Vertical direction of sliding roof front end and rear end.
Adjust by increasing or decreasing the number of shims.
NOTE: If the front end is high, even without a shoe shims, check to see if the front shoes are in contact with the stoppers.

content.description: Side view illustration showing vertical alignment check of sun roof with level indicator

content.text: Adjust by moving the front shoe on both sides.

content.description: Overhead view of sun roof adjustment mechanism showing front shoe with bidirectional arrows indicating forward-rearward adjustment capability
